depiction.primary_object: bold capital letters AD with two sound wave arcs
modifiers: two curved sound wave arcs on the right
depiction.composition: text glyph with right-side emission waves, centered horizontally

readings.meaning: audio description (accessibility narration track for video)
audio advertisement, radio spot, or podcast ad

ambiguity: Viewers unfamiliar with media accessibility standards read 'AD' with sound waves as an audio advertisement, radio commercial, or general ad rather than Audio Description.

modifier_semantics.modifier: two curved sound wave arcs on the right
modifier_semantics.meaning: audio, spoken narration, or broadcast sound

reasoning: The icon is the standard broadcast and streaming symbol for Audio Description ('AD' with sound waves), though many everyday users also read it as an audio or radio advertisement. It relies primarily on the two-letter abbreviation 'AD' and fits only a narrow set of media production, accessibility, or advertising tasks.
